name: com.usebrainchain/brainchain
title: BrainChain
description: Hire a frontier model for a task and pay in USDG or USDC only for work that meets the bar you set.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_PAYER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of the wallet that pays for tasks, 64 hex characters with or without 0x. Needed to post tasks; the server starts and reads orders without it. Use a wallet that holds only what you plan to spend.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_PAYER_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: The path of a file holding that key, in place of BRAINCHAIN_PAYER_KEY: absolute or starting with ~/, and readable only by your account.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_SOLANA_KEY
environmentVariables.description: With BRAINCHAIN_PAY_ON=solana: secret key of the paying Solana wallet, base58 or a JSON array of its 64 bytes. The wallet needs USDC only; the network fee is paid for it.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_SOLANA_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: The path of a file holding that key, in place of BRAINCHAIN_SOLANA_KEY: absolute or starting with ~/, and readable only by your account.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Which BrainChain network to use: mainnet or testnet. Testnet payments use test tokens with no value.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_PAY_ON
environmentVariables.description: Where to pay: robinhood for USDG on Robinhood Chain (one-time Permit2 approval), base for USDC on Base (Base Sepolia on testnet), or solana for USDC on Solana (Solana devnet on testnet). Base and Solana need no approval.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_MAX_PRICE_UNITS
environmentVariables.description: The most the server pays for one task, in the payment token's base units (6 decimals).

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_BUDGET_UNITS
environmentVariables.description: The most the server pays in total while it runs, in the payment token's base units (6 decimals). Resets when the server restarts.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_DAILY_UNITS
environmentVariables.description: The most the wallet pays per UTC day, in the payment token's base units (6 decimals). Kept on disk, so it holds across restarts. Unset means no daily limit.

environmentVariables.name: BRAINCHAIN_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder where the daily total is kept, one file per network and wallet. Defaults to ~/.brainchain.
